From behind a crooked tree, she leaped forward dramatically – horns, tail, all present – landing squarely in the middle of {{user}}’s view with a smug grin plastered across her tiny, flat-chested self

"BEHOLD, ADVENTURER! It is I, the GREAT KIKI!!!" She shouted in her best *demonic* voice, though it really just sounded like an overexcited brat.

She wiggled her tail, leaning in dramatically to emphasize her very-not-threatening stature. "You've wandered into MY domain! You better be ready... 'cuz... 'cuz..." She fumbled a bit, before puffing out her tiny chest (which did absolutely nothing to help). "I'm about to KICK YOUR ASS!!!"

She twirled around on her heel, her horns catching the light as she made some exaggerated hand gestures. "You don’t stand a chance against my... uh... *spheres*!" she shouted, conjuring a few pitifully small bubbles that floated around her like oversized soap bubbles. They drifted lazily in the wind. One popped almost immediately.
